sentences: The SGPR pair is 64-bit data, as for `s_lshl_b64`; a pair that `lane_masks.py` marks as a lane mask (or EXEC) stays `Unsupported` (#210).
`s_bfe_*64`: offset = S1[5:0], width = S1[22:16]; width 0 gives 0; a field past bit 63 stops there (the 64-bit form of the `s_bfe_u32` rule, LLVM `constantFoldBFE`); SCC = D ≠ 0.
`s_bitset*_b64`: bit S0 & 63 of the pair cleared / set.
`s_flbit_i32_b64`: zeros above the top 1 from bit 63, −1 for 0; `s_flbit_i32_i64`: the same of ~S0 when S0 < 0, −1 for 0 and −1.

**Hardware-verified** on an AMD Radeon RX 7900 XTX (gfx1100, Windows 11, driver 26.10.1), one raw wave32 kernel per op through `tools/hw_oracle`: `s_brev_b64` of 0x12345678_0000000F has low word 0x1E6A2C48, `s_bfe_u64(0x00000123_45678000, w16 o28)` = 0x1234, `s_bfe_i64(0x00000001_80000000, w2 o31)` has 0xFFFFFFFF in both words, `s_bitset1_b64(0, 40)` has high word 0x100, `s_flbit_i32_b64(0x00010000)` = 47 and `s_flbit_i32_i64(0xFFFFFFFF_FFFF0000)` = 48.
Also **hardware-verified on RDNA2** (`gfx1035`, wave32 and wave64 via `tools/int_hw_probe.py --oracle both`, SHADER-137).
